PCCARD: A removable memory or I/O device that fits into an expansion slot on a notebook computer or a personal digital assistant
PCDOS: A proprietary disk operating system variant developed and marketed by IBM.
PCI: Initialism of Peripheral Component Interconnect, a type of expansion slot on a motherboard.
PCIEXPRESS: A high-speed serial computer expansion bus standard, designed to replace the older PCI, PCI-X and AGP bus standards.
PCV: Initialism of passenger-carrying vehicle (typically, a bus).
